entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No. 6208 of 2019
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.417 of 2019, on the file of the I- Additional Junior Civil Judge, Sattenapalli, Guntur District, for the offences under Sections 188, 273, 420, 120(B) of IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: I- Additional Junior Civil Judge, Sattenapalli, Guntur District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2) Heard, Sri Kolla Venkateswara Rao, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Dilip Naik.

K,
learned junior counsel representing the learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent- State.
3) Both the learned counsel agree that the offences under which the petitioners have been charge sheeted were also the subject matter of the Crime No.107 of 2019.
Challenging the registration of the Crime No.107 of 2019, a Criminal Petition No.4722 of 2019 was filed.

Learned single judge of this Court clearly held that the offences are not made out and that the Tobacco products would not come within the definition of food, etc., and therefore, quashed the proceedings.

4) In view of the submission made and as the very same sections are the subject matter of this FIR also, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings in C.C.No.417 of 2019, on the file of the I-Additional Junior Civil Judge, Sattenapalli, Guntur District, for the offences under Sections 188,
273, 420, 120(B) of IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are quashed.

entities.text: I-Additional Junior Civil Judge, Sattenapalli, Guntur District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this petition shall stand closed.
